title: GET READY - 60s/70s Motown, Soul & Disco
subtitle: Sunday Matinee Special
description: GET READY Northampton - four hours of legendary 60s/70s Motown, Soul & Disco floorfillers. Banish the January blues!
fullDescription:
Remember when music made you MOVE? When every song on the radio had that irresistible groove that got your feet tapping before you even knew it?

GET READY takes you back to the golden era of Motown, Soul and Disco - four hours of the biggest floorfillers from the 60s and 70s. The songs that defined a generation, played loud, with people who feel exactly the same way.

This Sunday matinee is your antidote to the January blues. No dark nights, no late finishes - just pure, joyful dancing from 2pm to 6pm. Home in time for dinner, buzzing for the rest of the week.

title: THE 2PM CLUB Bedford: 80s Edition Daytime Disco
subtitle: Your best 80s night out. In the middle of the afternoon.
description: THE 2PM CLUB goes full-on 80s at Bedford Esquires. Your best 80s night out. In the middle of the afternoon.
fullDescription:
THE 2PM CLUB Daytime Disco is back at Bedford Esquires on Sat 12th September, 2pm-6pm. We’ve been packing this place out for a while now. This one’s different: for one afternoon, every song is 80s.

EXPECT TO HEAR

Madonna · Michael Jackson · Wham! · Whitney Houston · Bon Jovi · Prince · Duran Duran · A-ha · The Human League · Tina Turner · George Michael · Cyndi Lauper · Eurythmics · Culture Club · Tears For Fears · Simple Minds

The ones everyone knows. The ones where the room comes in before the chorus has properly started.

HOW IT WORKS

Doors at 2pm. Four hours of 80s anthems back to back, with your people.

Home by 7 if you want to be. Pub, food or sofa after if the afternoon does what it usually does.

WHAT PEOPLE SAY

“It felt like 2am not 2pm!”

“Absolutely fantastic afternoon out. Great music, fab people and a really safe environment”

“Great music, great atmosphere everyone was happy & friendly & we still had the evening to carry on!!”

That is the point: a proper night-out feeling, just at a time that works.

THE DETAILS

Bedford Esquires, Bedford
Sat 12th September 2026
2pm-6pm
Over 18s only

FAQs

Is this different to the normal 2PM Club?
Yes. Same daytime disco format, but this date is 80s-only for one afternoon.

Is it fancy dress?
Come as dressed-up or dressed-down as you like. The 80s are in the music, not a costume requirement.

What time does it finish?
Last song is 6pm. Plenty of time to go for food, carry on somewhere else, or be home by 7.

Who is it for?
Grown-ups who want a proper Saturday dance without giving Sunday away.

Are tickets refundable?
Tickets are non-refundable unless the event is cancelled.

Send it to the group chat and get it booked.

title: FAMILY SILENT DISCO Northampton
subtitle: Dance together, find your vibe!
description: FAMILY SILENT DISCO Northampton - Dance together while everyone finds their perfect vibe! Three channels of family-friendly fun.
fullDescription:
Have you ever tried dancing like nobody's watching... with headphones?

At our Family Silent Disco, everyone gets their own soundtrack while sharing the same dance floor! Kids can bounce to Party Hits, Teens to Charts/Trending while Parents groove to 80s/90s/00s favourites - all in the same space without compromising on music choices!

Perfect for kids 4+ and parents get to join the party too (in fact, the parents regularly enjoy it even more!). Three channels means everyone in the family finds their perfect music vibe.

We carefully curate all three family-friendly channels, drawing from our experience hosting both adult decades parties with Boombastic and school sessions through The Silent Disco Project.

fullDescription:
THE 2PM CLUB goes full-on 80s for one afternoon only.

We are back at The Picturedrome on Saturday 3 October, 2pm-6pm, and this time the whole dancefloor is 80s from start to finish.

Expect Madonna, Michael Jackson, Wham!, Whitney Houston, Bon Jovi, Prince, Duran Duran, A-ha, The Human League, Tina Turner, George Michael, Cyndi Lauper, Eurythmics, Culture Club, Tears For Fears and Simple Minds.

Same great 2PM Club format: doors at 2pm, four hours of big choruses, confetti moments and a room full of people who know every word. Home by 7 if you want to be.

title: BOOMBASTIC 90s Northampton
subtitle: All of the Nineties. Every Last Bit of It.
description: BOOMBASTIC: ALL OF THE NINETIES - four hours of pop perfection, Britpop anthems, dance floor euphoria and hip-hop swagger at The Picturedrome, Northampton.
fullDescription:
You had a favourite Spice Girl. You picked a side in August '95, Blur or Oasis, and you still stand by it. You knew every word to Don't Look Back in Anger before you even understood what it meant. The first time you heard Show Me Love in a sweaty room you didn't know what it was called, but you never forgot how it felt.

BOOMBASTIC: ALL OF THE NINETIES is four hours of that. Pop perfection, Britpop anthems, dance floor euphoria, hip-hop swagger - the whole decade, played exactly the way it should be. No filler. No apologies. No guilty pleasures, because in the 90s none of it was guilty.

This was the decade that proved genre didn't matter. You loved TLC and Oasis and Faithless and the Spice Girls all at the same time, and that was absolutely fine. It still is.
highlights: 🎵 The complete decade: Pop, Britpop, hip-hop, dance - all of it, four hours, no filler|📺 Giant screens: Authentic 90s videos - cheer when your favourites appear|🕺 Come as you are: Just be ready to sing every word|🎉 Every song an anthem: Every one of them yours
